messages:
alex.mendoza: hey team :wave: I accepted the org invite but I still can't see the infra repo (github.com/redwood-inference/infra-private). I get 'You don’t have access to this repository'.

emily.it: did you accept the SSO link after accepting the invite? we require org SSO + 2FA for private repos.

alex.mendoza: I turned on 2FA with an authenticator app earlier today. Where's the SSO link?

jordan.c: hey alex — welcome! The SSO link usually appears on the org page after you accept the invite, but sometimes it doesn't trigger. Try this: open https://github.com/redwood-inference and there should be a banner with 'Authorize SSO'. If not, ping me and I can trigger reprovisioning.

alex.mendoza: opened the org page, no banner. clicking on a private repo still shows the access error.

emily.it: ok, two things: 1) we sometimes need to add you to the correct team for nested repo permissions (infra lives under team "eng-infra/infra-owners"). 2) if your GitHub account email doesn't match the company directory email, SSO may not map. Can you confirm the email on your GitHub account?

alex.mendoza: it's alex.mendoza+redwood@gmail.com — that should match my directory email (alex.mendoza@redwood.ai) ?

jordan.c: different domains will fail mapping. You'll need to add your work email to your GitHub account (Settings → Emails) and set it as primary or at least verified. After that: 1) sign out and sign back into GitHub 2) visit the org page and accept the SSO.

alex.mendoza: ah ok adding now. will verify.

devex-bot: automated note: onboarding checklist for alex.mendoza — 1) add work email to GitHub 2) enable 2FA (done) 3) accept org SSO 4) request team access if needed. See https://intranet.redwood.ai/onboarding/devex for details.

alex.mendoza: email added and verified. signed out/in and I see the SSO banner. clicking 'Authorize SSO' now...

alex.mendoza: OK authorized. still can't push to infra repo though — can clone, but push returns "remote: Permission to redwood-inference/infra-private.git denied to alex.mendoza."

nora-ops: that means you have read but not write. infra-private is restricted to eng-infra/infra-owners team. @jordan.c can you add alex to infra-owners?

jordan.c: on it. I'm going to add you to 'eng-infra' and nested 'infra-owners' with write. give me a minute.

jordan.c: added. you might need to refresh your access tokens if you use a PAT.

alex.mendoza: thanks! testing push... still blocked. I'm using the GitHub desktop app — should I try command line?

emily.it: try `git remote -v` and `git push` from terminal to see full error. If you're using a PAT, make sure it's got repo scope and was created after the SSO authorization. If using SSH, make sure your SSH key is registered in your GitHub settings.

alex.mendoza: here's the error from terminal: 
```
remote: Permission to redwood-inference/infra-private.git denied to alex.mendoza.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-private.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```

alex.mendoza: I did generate a PAT yesterday but it was before I authorized SSO — could that be it?

nora-ops: yep PATs inherit access at creation time and may not be linked to SSO. Revoke the old PAT and create a new one with 'repo' scope after SSO is authorized. Or use SSH: add your public key (cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub) to GitHub -> Settings -> SSH and GPG keys.

alex.mendoza: created a new PAT with repo scope and re-ran push, success :tada: I can push now.

jordan.c: awesome, welcome aboard! I'll also add you to the 'redwood-devs' common team so you get CI and workspace access.

alex.mendoza: appreciate the quick help — any onboarding docs I should read for infra repo conventions?

devex-bot: recommended reading: 1) infra/README.md in repo, 2) CONTRIBUTING.md, 3) internal runbooks at https://intranet.redwood.ai/infra/runbooks. Also check the access matrix doc: https://intranet.redwood.ai/security/access-matrix.

emily.it: one small follow-up: make sure you add the company email as a verified secondary in case you need org invites in the future. We'll close this thread after you confirm everything's good.

alex.mendoza: confirmed everything works, thanks everyone :rocket:

jordan.c: welcome again :wave: editing memberships in case we need anything else. closing thread in a bit.
